visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot shows a finished matcha bagel with a thick, glossy chocolate glaze being held by hands against a blurry background. (2) A block of white tofu sits on a wooden table; hands use a white paper towel to gently press and absorb moisture from its surface. (3) The tofu is placed into a clear plastic ziplock bag. Hands then pour white glutinous rice flour and vibrant green matcha powder from glass bowls into the bag. (4) Hands vigorously press and knead the mixture inside the bag on the wooden surface until a uniform green dough is formed. (5) The green dough is removed from the bag, placed on a pink silicone mat, and cut into sections with a knife. Hands then roll these sections into balls and poke holes in the middle to create a bagel shape. (6) The shaped bagels are placed on parchment paper inside a small toaster oven; the heating elements glow orange as they bake. (7) A final close-up returns to the finished bagel, showcasing its cracked texture and rich chocolate coating.
